column2: # 中文：在评分数值轴上按 room_type 分组绘制密度，半透明颜色用于比较各组的分布位置与形状。
# English: Plot rating densities separately by room_type, using translucent fills to compare distribution locations and shapes.
# 中文：本块没有 drop_na(review_scores_rating)，因此评分缺失时 geom_density() 会删除相应值并可能发出警告。
# English: There is no drop_na(review_scores_rating) here, so geom_density() excludes missing ratings and may issue a warning.
# 中文：警告不是把 NA 变成 0；核对排除数及分组缺失情况，避免把剩余样本当作全部房源。
# English: The warning does not mean NA became zero; check exclusions and missingness by group before generalising to all listings.
# 中文：这里原 y 标签 Count 同样不准确；实际默认 y 是每组归一化的概率密度，不能用曲线高度比较组总数。
# English: Count is again an inaccurate y label; the default is a normalised density for each group, so heights do not compare group totals.
